invariants.rationale: The metaClient parameter is likely expected to be non-null for the method to interact with table metadata.
It is standard to require input lists such as columnsToIndex to be non-null.
If the list is non-empty, its first element is expected to be not null.
The size() of a List is always non-negative.
It is reasonable to expect the input list columnsToIndex not to contain null elements.
